standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, section on differentials (definition of Omega and d_{X/Y})
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the objects and the universal derivation whose functoriality is being established.

standard_prerequisites.name: Adjointness of f_* and f^* for a morphism of ringed topoi
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, section on morphisms of ringed topoi
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the map into the pushforward form into the map c_f in the pullback form.

core_obligations: Show that the composite of f^sharp with f_* d_{X'/Y'} is a Y-derivation, so that the canonical map Omega_{X/Y} -> f_* Omega_{X'/Y'} exists, and obtain c_f by adjointness of f_* and f^* (proof lines 6508-6519, the part the author calls clear).
For the characterisation, let U be an object and t a local section of O_X on U, viewed as a map h_U^# -> O_X, and exhibit f^* t as the composite of f^{-1} t with f^sharp (proof lines 6520-6534).

Exhibit f^* d_{X/Y}(t) similarly as the composite of f^{-1} d_{X/Y}(t) with the pullback of the structure map, and verify that c_f carries it to d_{X'/Y'}(f^* t), completing the proof up to line 6550 (proof lines 6535-6550).
proof_roadmap: Form the Y-derivation and take adjoints to get the canonical map.
Unfold the pullback of a section as an explicit composite.
Check the defining property for that composite.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the canonical map c_f : f^* Omega_{X/Y} -> Omega_{X'/Y'} attached to a commutative diagram of ringed topoi and proves that it is uniquely characterized by the property that f^* d_{X/Y}(t) maps to d_{X'/Y'}(f^* t). The proof observes that everything except the characterization is clear, then unfolds the meaning of the pullback of a local section: the section is viewed as a map of sheaves of sets from h_U^# to O_X, and both f^* t and f^* d_{X/Y}(t) are exhibited as explicit compositions of pullback and the structure map f^sharp, so that the required compatibility becomes a statement about compositions of these displayed maps (proof lines 6508-6550). H2: the unfolding of the pullback of a section and the verification of the defining property through the displayed compositions is the substance.
